description.en: This genus-level Chalicotherium has long powerful clawed forelimbs, shorter hindlimbs and a horse-like head. Whole-body form is partly based on an interpretive skeletal illustration; soft tissues and the knuckle-supported stance are reconstructed, not directly observed.
description.zh: 此属级爪兽 Chalicotherium 具有强壮修长的带爪前肢、较短后肢和马状头部。全身形态部分依据解释性骨架绘图；软组织及指节支撑姿态属于复原，而非直接观察所得。

construction_notes: Keep side-view fore/hindlimb length contrast clear; do not hide it through crouching alone.
No aggressive behavior, branch pulling or gorilla ancestry claim. Modest short coat color is artistic.
Do not use obsolete1911 mounted skeleton or substitute Moropus/Anisodon fossil images as Chalicotherium.

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Artistic genus-level envelope, not specimen or sex-specific measurement.

frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block long powerful clawed forelimbs and much shorter hindlimbs with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织长而有力的爪前肢与明显较短后肢；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: long powerful clawed forelimbs and much shorter hindlimbs. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：长而有力的爪前肢与明显较短后肢。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

scientific_limits.en: Only the jaw reference is a photographed fossil; the full-body reference is an interpretive skeletal illustration. Forelimb/hindlimb contrast follows published description, while exact joints, claw sheaths, soft tissue, ears, hair, color, posture and dimensions are estimates. Knuckle-supported stance is a reconstruction, not directly observed behavior.
scientific_limits.zh: 只有颌部参考是化石照片；全身参考为解释性骨架绘图。前后肢比例对照依据已发表的描述，而精确关节、爪鞘、软组织、耳、毛、颜色、姿态及尺寸为估值。指节支撑姿态为复建，不是直接观察到的行为。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original genus-level Chalicotherium living stylization, using real jaw fossil photo and clearly identified skeletal illustration for whole-body guidance. Not an exact species or individual reconstruction.
shape_requirements: Original long powerful clawed forelimbs and much shorter hindlimbs remain dominant.
High shoulders slope distinctly toward lower hindquarters; long forearms remain separate from deep barrel torso.
Horse-like elongate head and short neck, not a gorilla face or giant-sloth head.
Forefeet retain strong curved claw tips with curled-back geometry in a restrained knuckle-supported pose; no ordinary rounded horse hooves.
frozen_scientific_scope.taxon_scope: Chalicotherium sp.; no relabeling of Moropus or Anisodon mounts
